news.title: Asian Stocks Shrug Off Tariff Jitters
news.summary: Asian stocks rose broadly, with South Korea and Taiwan setting records, despite renewed trade uncertainty.  Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index rose 2.5%.   South Korea’s Kospi composite closed at a record high, as did its biggest component, Samsung Electronics.

news.title: Indian Stocks Advance After U.S. Agrees to Slash Tariffs
news.summary: Indian stocks jumped after President Trump agreed to slash tariffs on the country. The U.S. is lowering levies on Indian goods to 18% after the two nations struck a trade pact and Trump said New Delhi, led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, agreed to stop buying Russian oil.

news.title: London Stock Exchange open to dual listing of Indian companies, says LSEG boss
news.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves has pushed for India to allow companies to have a dual listing on the London Stock Exchange
